# Hasnain Alam

> **Hasnain Alam** is a Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in the **MERN Stack, Next.js, TypeScript, React Native, Electron.js, and modern web technologies**. He builds high-performance web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, desktop software, and free online developer tools.

Hasnain Alam is a multi-platform software engineer focused on building production-ready, scalable solutions across **Web, Mobile, Desktop, and Developer Utilities**. He is available for freelance projects, remote engagements, technical consulting, and long-term software development partnerships.

---

# Services

* [Services Overview](https://hasnainalam.com/services): Complete list of software development services.

* [MERN Stack Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/mern-stack-development): Custom full-stack applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.

* [Next.js Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/nextjs-development): SEO-friendly, high-performance web applications using Next.js with SSR, SSG, ISR, and API Routes.

* [React.js Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/react-js-development): Interactive React applications, reusable component libraries, and modern frontend architecture.

* [Node.js Backend Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/nodejs-backend-development): REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, authentication systems, scalable backend architecture, and database integration.

* [React Native App Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/react-native-development): Cross-platform Android & iOS applications with native functionality and App Store deployment.

* [Electron.js Desktop App Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/electron-desktop-development): Native desktop software for Windows, macOS, and Linux with offline-first capabilities.

* [E-commerce Website Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/ecommerce-website-development): Custom online stores with payment gateways, inventory management, and scalable architecture.

* [SaaS Website Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/saas-website-development): End-to-end SaaS platforms with authentication, subscriptions, dashboards, and multi-tenant architecture.

* [Landing Page Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/landing-page-development): High-converting landing pages optimized for SEO, Core Web Vitals, and lead generation.

* [WordPress Development](https://hasnainalam.com/services/wordpress-development): Custom WordPress websites, themes, plugins, headless WordPress, and CMS integrations.

* [API Integration Services](https://hasnainalam.com/services/api-integration-services): Payment gateways, CRMs, AI APIs, cloud services, and third-party integrations.

* [Website Maintenance & Support](https://hasnainalam.com/services/website-maintenance-support): Continuous maintenance, security updates, optimization, monitoring, and technical support.

* [Hire Full-Stack Developer](https://hasnainalam.com/services/hire-full-stack-developer): Hire Hasnain Alam as a dedicated freelance or remote full-stack developer.

* [Hire Freelance Web Developer](https://hasnainalam.com/services/hire-freelance-web-developer): Flexible freelance development services for startups, agencies, and businesses.

# Developer Tools

The website also provides a growing collection of **free online developer, SEO, text, and productivity tools** designed for developers, content creators, marketers, and students.

## Tools Overview

* [Developer Tools](https://hasnainalam.com/tools): Browse all free online tools.

Individual tools include:

* [Base64 Converter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/base64-converter): Encode and decode Base64 strings instantly.

* [Case Converter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/case-converter): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, and camelCase.

* [Color Converter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/color-converter): Convert HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CSS color formats.

* [JSON Formatter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/json-formatter): Beautify, validate, and minify JSON data.

* [Password Generator](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/password-generator): Generate secure random passwords with customizable options.

* [Slug Generator](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/slug-generator): Create clean SEO-friendly URL slugs from text.

* [Timestamp Converter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps into readable dates and vice versa.

* [Word Counter](https://hasnainalam.com/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time.

Every tool has its own SEO-optimized page located at:

* `/tools/[tool-slug]`
